title: Chandi Kumar Das Karmakar v. Abanidhar Roy

content.caseIdentity: Chandi Kumar Das Karmakar v. Abanidhar Roy, AIR 1965 SC 585
content.holding: Held that where property is removed under a bona fide assertion of a genuine claim of right made in good faith, dishonest intention is completely negated, and criminal liability for theft cannot be fastened.
